Get an effective extension to your in-house team to build cutting-edge applications tailored to your unique needs. Our professional Golang developers can use Go to design and implement cloud-native applications that leverage the full potential of platforms like AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

API Development

Engage the best Golang programmers to build APIs that handle high traffic and complex workflows. Our specialists have extensive experience creating RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC APIs, as well as performance optimization, enabling your APIs to handle high-concurrency environments.

Maintenance and Support

Extend your development team with professional Golang specialists, who will help you implement a go-to language for decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, custom infrastructure. We have hands-on experience creating blockchain solutions for finance, healthcare, supply chain, and more.

AI and Machine Learning

Gain access to top-tier Golang talent with in-depth knowledge of AI / ML and integrating their capabilities into existing apps, backed with expertise in frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch (via Go bindings), custom ML libraries, and deployment of AI models in real-time systems with low-latency processing.

{methods}

Methods Used By Our Go Specialists

Test-Driven Development (TDD)

Our software specialists can help you ensure that every line of code is purposeful and aligned with your project’s requirements. By defining clear requirements and expected outcomes upfront, Test-Driven Development leads to a focus on the required behavior, early detection of issues, and future-proof apps.

Efficient API Development

Mobilunity’s Go developers use lightweight frameworks like Gin, Echo, and Fiber to help you design robust and scalable APIs. Working in full compliance with OpenAPI standards, they deliver clear documentation, high performance, and seamless integration for service communication in custom ecosystems.

Agile Development

By adopting Agile methodologies, our Golang developers can help you ensure flexibility, transparency, and rapid delivery throughout every phase of your project. They can easily adapt to changing requirements, ensuring the final product aligns with your evolving needs and eventually has a faster time-to-market.

Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)

Our Golang developers can deliver high-quality software through streamlined workflows powered by CI/CD pipelines. They can help you with automated testing, version control integration, seamless deployment, and monitoring loops for greater scalability, faster time-to-market, and reduced risks.

Monitoring and Logging

By leveraging tools like Prometheus / Grafana for real-time monitoring and Zap / Logrus for structured logging, our professional developers and software experts can provide you with actionable insights that help with proactive troubleshooting and efficient system optimization.

Agile Development

By breaking down monolithic apps into smaller, independent services, our software experts can help you achieve agile development, faster deployment, and scaling. They use Golang’s concurrency, containerization, and API-driven communication for robust integration, security, and high performance.

Real-Time Data Processing

Our software developers are harnessing lightweight Goroutines and tools like Kafka, RabbitMQ, and WebSocket to support your project with high-throughput, low-latency systems. They will help you create real-time data processing pipelines and build effective event-driven architectures.

Cloud-Native Development

Expert software engineers from Mobilunity can help you utilize Golang’s lightweight nature and high concurrency for real-time data processing and event-driven architectures. They will ensure optimal resource usage and perfect scaling across cloud-native environments like AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.

Containerization

Using Golang packaging and resource management, our Go programmers can help you implement secure container practices and optimize apps for high-concurrency and low-latency performance. They use tools like Docker and Kubernetes to ensure your Golang app runs consistently across all environments.

Load Testing & Performance Optimization

Professional programmers from Mobilunity can help you with analyzing and improving the efficiency of your Go applications, high-concurrency optimization, database tuning, code refactoring, and load testing. They use tools like k6 and Apache JMeter for ensuring systems can handle high loads under stress.

Version Control and Collaboration

Focusing on maintaining high-quality standards, our Go developers and software experts follow rigorous code review practices, using Git for version control and seamless collaboration. This ensures every release or software update is fully functional, consistent, maintainable, and aligned with your quality standards.

Secure Coding Practices

By integrating security into every stage of development, our software specialists can help you apply best coding practices, including input validation, data encryption, dependency management, and regular audits. This leads to reduced risks of data breaches and makes scaling your systems safer and easier.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the benefits of having Golang developers from Mobilunity?

With over 14 years of experience, we offer top pre-vetted Golang talents, connecting you only with the most fitting developers from our own talent pool and across the globe. By having Golang developers from Mobilunity, you gain access to exceptional people, flexible hiring options, cost-efficiency, and a focus on high-quality, secure development. As for the Golang programming language itself, Go has become an efficient tool and a popular choice for many modern software development projects. Known for its relative simplicity and robust performance, Go has a built-in package for command-line apps, real-time data processing, and microservices. It enables developers to build performance-critical applications and comprehensive cloud-based enterprise-grade solutions.

How does Mobilunity ensure the quality of its Golang developers?

We combine a thorough vetting process and tech evaluation to ensure only the best and most experienced Golang developers are going to join your project. We hand-pick developers based on their deep understanding of the Go programming language and their ability to apply best practices in real-world applications. Our recruitment process involves technical screenings with comprehensive coding tests and practical assignments, behavior interviews to confirm strong communication, collaboration skills, and cultural fit, as well as reference checks to verify previous experience and performance track record.

What engagement models do you have and how much does it cost to hire senior Golang developers?

We offer flexible engagement models to help you hire a Golang developer – or experts working with other programming languages – based on your specific development process and the global objectives of the business. Whether you’re looking for a dedicated team of Golang specialists, a single full-time / part-time expert, or just need a helping hand through expert consultancy or tech leadership (for example, remote CTO), Mobilunity has an engagement model and time zone overlaps tailored to your requirements.

How quickly can Mobilunity provide experts for my Golang project?

Prioritizing efficiency and speed, we are doing our best to provide you with the right Golang developers within 2-6 weeks. The actual timeline for hiring top Golang developers or other niche experts depends on the engagement model of your choice, the team composition, and the complexity of your project requirements. For a dedicated development team, it usually takes 4-6 weeks to build a new crew from scratch and get them on board. For project-based engagement, we can get started within 2-3 weeks, after discussing the project scope and requirements. For consulting / advisory services, our Golang experts, backend developers, or software consultants can be usually deployed within 1-2 weeks and assist you with strategic recommendations, technical audits, or architecture planning without taking too much time for onboarding / integration.

What types of projects are your Go specialists experienced in?

Golang developers from us can have experience with Golang across different types of projects, like Golang custom and cross-platform software development, microservices architecture, Golang Web app development, cloud-native applications, web and mobile, API development, AI and Machine Learning, Blockchain development, as well as maintenance and support, code review and performance optimization.

How does Mobilunity handle the onboarding process for new Golang developers?

By taking a structured approach to onboarding, we enable your new team members to hit the ground running and ensure long-term success right from day one. Taking care that every software expert from Mobilunity is not only technically proficient but shares your company’s culture and vision, we facilitate open communication and provide continuous support. We help to set up the necessary tools and environments to turn the hiring process, integration and onboarding into a maximum seamless and controllable experience for all.

How does Mobilunity support the long-term retention of Golang developers?

By focusing on a holistic approach to developer retention, we ensure that all our tech specialists and consultants are engaged, supported, and motivated. We offer employee well-being programs, a supportive HR and leadership crew, comprehensive benefits, as well as access to the latest technologies and challenging projects – all this helps our programmers and consultants stay engaged, motivated, happy, and committed to the long-term success of our clients.

Can I scale a team of Golang developers up or down based on project needs?

Sure, if you’re looking to hire professionals and stay flexible, Mobilunity has you covered. Our core approach is to offer maximum scaling options for your development team. You can easily adjust the size and composition of your team based on your current project needs and global business expectations. Whether you need to immediately scale up (for example, to meet tight deadlines, adapt to seasonal peaks in workload, respond to emerging challenges) or scale down once certain milestones are reached, we can easily help you accommodate these ever-changing and often unpredictable demands – without disrupting your core operations.
